info.title: Control D Universal API
info.description: Manage DNS profiles, endpoints, filters, and analytics

put.description: Updates multiple filters for a profile in Control D.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

value.description: Filter identifier returned by the batch filter update response.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

post.description: Creates a custom rule in Control D.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

do.description: Rule type. 0 = BLOCK. 1 = BYPASS, 2 = SPOOF, 3 = REDIRECT. <<glossary:Do>>

via.description: Spoof/Redirect target. If SPOOF, this can be an IPv4 or hostname. If REDIRECT, this must be a valid proxy identifier. <<glossary:Via>>

viaV6.description: If SPOOF this can be a valid IPv6 address (AAAA record)

group.description: Optional ID of the folder to create this rule in, root folder if ommited

clientCount.description: Number of devices using this Endpoint

profileId.description: Primary key of main profile to enforce on this device

profileId2.description: Primary key of a second profile to enforce

stats.description: Set analytics level on device. 0 = off, 1 = basic, 2 = full

legacyIpv4Status.description: Set this to 1 to generate a legacy IPv4 (and IPv6) DNS resolver.

learnIp.description: Enable or disable automatic IP learning and logging. 0 to disable, 1 to enable.

restricted.description: Make this device restricted, only previously authorized IPs will be able to query against it

desc.description: Add a description or comment to the device

ddnsStatus.description: Status of DDNS endpoint that exposes last used IP.

ddnsSubdomain.description: DDNS subdomain to expose the IP on

ddnsExtStatus.description: Status of DDNS based IP learning

ddnsExtHost.description: DDNS hostname to query to learn new IPs

remapDeviceId.description: Remap source device + client ID to a new device

remapClientId.description: Remap source device + client ID to a new device
